utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help—what exactly needs to be repaired for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the drive needs a few fixes, but I’m blanking on the exact list. I think it was mostly the gate and a couple of the lane markers.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Cleo — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — I’m keeping track of what we still need, and tools would help a lot. I’ll let you know the list as soon as I finish checking it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help where I can, but I need to keep things simple right now. What’s left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Uli — mostly we just need a few more people to sort donations and a ride for the larger items. If you can help with one simple task, that would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — did I miss the repair drive details?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries, Dane — you didn’t miss it. I’m just getting the repair drive details together, and I can fill you in now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—just tell me what’s needed and when you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—can you come by Saturday morning, and are you okay helping with sorting donations and lifting boxes?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—what does the repair drive need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly tools and a couple spare parts, honestly. I skimmed the list, but I know we’re short on those.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s wonderful, Jules — thank you! I’ll start inviting folks right away and send anyone interested your way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep an eye on the repair drive locations and note any updates. Just tell me where to check first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — could you check the community center bulletin board first? If anything’s changed, I’d really appreciate a note.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when do you need me there?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Eli — I’m still getting the details together, but it’s looking like a simple drop-off and sort on Saturday morning. I’ll let you know the exact time as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard about the repair drive, but I’m still catching up on the details. Is there anything you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Nell — I’m good for now, but if you can help sort tools or carry a few boxes, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is definitely happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely — it’s on for this weekend, and folks are already signing up to help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d like to know the timing and where we’re dropping things off first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — we’re aiming for Saturday morning, and the drop-off is at the community center on Maple. I’ll keep everyone posted as the plan gets firmer.
